method: Raw host-to-MCU serial_tx W packets require A5 5A W prefix, exact 5+6*n length, valid XOR checksum and written_bytes equal complete length. Their monotonic timestamps determine command cadence.
Decode <BhHB records for servo ID/count/speed/acc; compare exact tuples on successive uncapped packets.

Raw electrical health uses existing feedback records and explicit snapshot servo reports in the same 8s windows. CSV active/comparator values use recorded phase labels, which can include edge/wait overhead.
CSV bus_current_a is the sum of sampled servo currents, not an independent battery current sensor.

CSV roll/pitch and sparse raw IMU samples describe sampled attitude; dynamic acceleration affects accelerometer tilt. No frequency estimate or smoothness ranking is inferred from sparse encoder/IMU samples.
Contact-model probabilities are not physical contact measurements and are intentionally excluded.
Host serial transmission does not by itself prove exact per-servo electrical receipt time.

temperature_data_quality.interpretation: Isolated reported spikes (including 31->142->31 C) revert within one adjacent feedback sample and are inconsistent with physical motor heating/cooling. Retain as telemetry anomalies, not confirmed hot motors; no value is silently removed from reported maxima. Underlying cause not determined by this audit.

findings: Four completed programmed gait1 walking cells; all validated raw motor-goal frames contain IDs2..19 at fixed speed2000/acc80.
Host command cadence98.0388,97.5246,97.4654,97.4047Hz for low30,high30,high40,low40; no >30ms gap and no capture drops/failed recorded serial exchanges.
All sampled full feedback arrays and distinct snapshots contained all18 encoders; electrical-current peaks remained <=0.52A per servo and sampled minimum voltage>=11.1V.
Temperature maxima include isolated impossible transients and cannot be interpreted as confirmed heat; normal distribution p95 is33C in each walking cell.

All-joint duplicate W frames are11.3–11.8% in every cell. Raising alpha reduces per-joint exact tuple duplicates at fixed speed; duplicate fraction alone does not explain stronger shaking at high alpha.

Sampled walking tilt exceeds stationary hold tilt; this sparse attitude/encoder stream cannot establish2–3Hz oscillation amplitude, frequency, or reliable smoothness ranking. Use synchronized fresh video for that comparison.
